Privacy Policy

Effective {{POLICY_DATE}}. Version 2.

1. Who we are

The controller of your personal data is Individual Entrepreneur {{OPERATOR_FIO_EN}} (Tomsk, Russian Federation; OGRNIP {{OPERATOR_OGRNIP}}, INN {{OPERATOR_INN}}), "we", "us". Contact for any privacy matter: {{PD_EMAIL}}.

This policy covers: - the website sedlab.dev (the "Site"); - the international demo edition at <name>-en.demo.sedlab.dev (the "INTL Demos"); - the Russian demo edition at <name>.demo.sedlab.dev and its sign-in service auth.demo.sedlab.dev (the "RU Demos"), if you choose to use them; - communications and contracts with clients.

2. INTL Demos: no account, no stored personal data

The INTL Demos run in demo mode only: test data and simulated third-party services. There is no sign-in. We do not keep what you enter after your session ends. Our web server keeps technical logs for up to 14 days, with IP addresses truncated (last octet removed) and without cookies or authorization headers. The INTL Demos run on servers of DigitalOcean in Frankfurt, Germany.

3. What else we process, why, and for how long

Purpose Data Legal basis (GDPR Art. 6(1)) Retention
Enquiries via the Site form and correspondence name, the contact you choose (Telegram, email or phone), task description, budget, deadline, date, source page (b) steps at your request prior to entering a contract; (a) your consent, as required by Russian law 12 months after last contact if no contract is concluded

We do not process special categories of data or real payment card data (demos use payment sandboxes only), and we make no decisions with legal or similarly significant effects based solely on automated processing (Art. 22). The services are intended for persons aged 18+.

4. Where data is stored and who receives it

  • Russian Federation. Enquiries, client data and RU Demos accounts are stored on servers of Selectel JSC in Moscow, with encrypted backups at a separate Russian storage provider. Russian law requires personal data of Russian citizens to be stored in Russia, and we apply the same storage to all users.
  • Sign-in providers of the RU Demos (Max, Yandex ID, VK ID; all in Russia) provide your ID, name and login when you sign in. We do not use foreign sign-in services.
  • Live-mode providers of the RU Demos (Russian speech, language-model, payment-sandbox and CRM-sandbox services, listed on each Demo page) receive only the content of your request, without identifiers.
  • Infrastructure providers (hosting, storage). Backups are encrypted before upload.
  • Authorities, only where required by law.

We do not sell personal data or share it for third-party advertising.

International transfers. If you are in the EEA or the UK and send us an enquiry, your data is collected by us directly and stored in Russia, which has no adequacy decision. Where Chapter V GDPR applies, we rely on Art. 49(1)(b): the transfer is necessary for steps you request before a contract. EDPB Guidelines 05/2021: прямой сбор данных оператором вне ЕС у субъекта из ЕС не считается «передачей» по гл. V; формулировку проверить у юриста.

5. Your rights

You have the right to access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20), and to object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21). You can withdraw consent at any time without affecting earlier processing (Art. 7(3)).

  • RU Demos account: use "Download my data" and "Delete account" at auth.demo.sedlab.dev/account.
  • Anything else: email {{PD_EMAIL}}. We reply within one month (Art. 12(3)); for requests from Russia, within 10 working days as required by Russian law.
  • Complaints: you may lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority (for example, an EU data protection authority) or with Roskomnadzor (rkn.gov.ru).

6. Cookies

INTL Demos set no tracking cookies. The RU Demos sign-in uses only strictly necessary cookies: - sl_auth: session, 30 days; - sl_login: binds Max bot sign-in to your browser, 5 minutes; - sl_oauth: protects Yandex ID and VK ID sign-in, 10 minutes; - a temporary signed cookie that holds sign-in provider data until you accept the consent screen.

No analytics or advertising cookies are used.

7. Security

Our security measures: - data minimisation; - TLS everywhere; - sign-in tokens signed in Russia; - internal interfaces closed to the public network; - encrypted backups; - access limited to the controller; - truncated IPs in logs; - automatic deletion of inactive accounts.

We notify supervisory authorities and affected users of personal data breaches where required (GDPR Art. 33 and 34; Russian law: within 24 and 72 hours).

8. Changes

We publish updates on this page with a new effective date. If purposes or data change materially, we ask for consent again where consent is the basis. The Russian version (sedlab.dev/privacy) prevails for data subjects in Russia.
